internal/tasks/authority and internal/tasks/store produce identical per-test go test -json outcomes unconfined and under .github/testconfine in the CI container, and carry a measured entry in .corvint/test-read-scopes.json
body:
Found 2026-10-01 while measuring floor packages for AFP-V0-023 declarations (PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/452, build log docs/build-log/2026-10-01-declared-floor-read-scopes.md). internal/tasks/authority and internal/tasks/store are on the unbounded-reader floor because of repository literals in fixture data, and together cost about 430 package-seconds per merge (authority 307, store 124 in the 16-merge attribution). Expected: a declared read scope confines them. Actual: both pass unconfined and fail under the Landlock wrapper in golang:1.27.1 (Landlock ABI 4), because the Tasks store opens / to walk a path one component at a time and Landlock cannot grant / without granting the whole tree. Options: make the store's component walk start below the root it needs (for example openat from an allowed ancestor), or confine these packages by another mechanism. Corvint version: branch build of claude/declare-floor-read-scopes (AFP-V0-023 planner).

2026-10-01 V1-0649 continuation: reproduced safeopen open / permission denied under Landlock ABI4, then Linux traversal-only O_PATH descriptors pass unprivileged confined/unconfined regression and both full authority/store runs. Exact go-test-json comparison also found a confirmed test-reporting bug: TestTMV0009_AS11_FixtureFoundationEveryPublicationPrefix/INIT/durable-post:pinned/<digest>.json embeds the per-run temporary-path digest, producing different test identities despite both outcomes passing. Reproduction: identical candidate source in golang:1.27.1 with executable tmpfs, go test -json -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/tasks/authority versus -exec PR438 test-confine; one case differs only in digest. Expected: stable named fault cases for exact outcome parity. Fix in progress: stable durable-post:pinned subtest label, retain the original fault-injection boundary. Source base 02567f9ab07bd24ec11d9fd043b8b80ebe6e4c2f; installed Core rc1 build163/Tasks dev build202; planner PR438 b6e38e477f3176e9e90d7cf949aa17db592b1597. Acceptance: complete identical per-test outcomes including skips, terminal package passes, and unprivileged safety regression. AFP declaration delivery still depends on PR438; do not close before integration and native completion. Wider V1-0310 authority recovery is not claimed.

Delivery evidence 2026-10-01: ready-for-review source PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/474 at a4f0f0eab04a921da675898ab35be97c637d61e5; source commit 0e32094baf5787e78976afac9a5f6923921305b9. Independent source/repair review PASS (no HIGH/MED). Fifteen Tasks packages and focused vet PASS. golang:1.27.1 executable tmpfs, Landlock ABI4: authority/store/safeopen all pass; 983 per-test outcomes match exactly (978 pass, 5 identical skips) plus 3 package passes; unprivileged permission regression passes both modes. A PR438-based committed probe 9fe7e391d6ddbfa28c470e0886e44a55688debab excludes authority/store on a README-only diff, retaining 15 planner unknowns. Two-entry declaration patch retained at /private/tmp/codex-ci-affected-0649/.git/corvint/ci-0649/qualification-declarations.patch. CEM checked target727aade3eae09db12e7248e7ebf8572b746eae03: nine supported, zero unknown; frozen selected workflow satisfied and dogfood-check PASS. Required seal at a4f0f0ea PASS; current-head enrollment becomes stale after archive rename (existing ci-keyed-finish-seal-compat / V1-0493). Six OCM requirements remain unassessed; attempted link to CLI test rejected claim-obligation-mismatch because exact ID is outside function anchor, and no fabricated link was retained. Source review supports the bounded implementation, not broader V1-0310 closure. GitHub CI is pending. Keep OPEN for source landing, PR438 admin status and landing, declaration integration, recorded full-gate disposition, and native completion write. Coordination chat handles merges. Evidence/checkpoint: /private/tmp/codex-ci-affected-0649/.git/corvint/ci-0649/.

Final forward repair 2026-10-01: hosted Linux amd64 CI at initial474a4f0f0ea found confirmed compilation error syscall.O_PATH undefined. Exact amd64 test-binary cross-compile reproduced; arm64 local qualification had not established amd64 portability. Linux ABI0x200000 replacement reviewed against all13 supported Go Linux architectures. Forward seal revert ef4c635a and source repair f5ea39e8e60a3ac8e484401555add173899588ac preserve history, original base02567f9a, key3d66c021 and frozen pland3a24340. Repaired source: Linux amd64 safeopen test binary and all Tasks packages compile PASS; full arm64 Linux parity again983 identical per-test outcomes plus3 package passes, unprivileged regression PASS; all three frozen checks pass and qualify at new CEM bind ef8df31d76b565e1529107ce5ee8f1c0618eeca3. Independent final repair review PASS, no findings. Renewed finish satisfied=true and dogfood-check/seal PASS; latest source PR474 head f9bfe8cad9f240387bf36ab2c0995fae7cdf3b84. Current sealed-head status remains stale under existing ci-keyed-finish-seal-compat; no frozen-state/base edits, cancellation or masked HEAD switch. Six OCM obligations remain unassessed. Hosted amd64 runtime CI is pending on latest head. Native evidence carrier475 is updated with this record. Ticket remains OPEN for declared-scope integration, landing, gate disposition and native completion; full-gate NOT_RUN. Detailed retained handoff at /private/tmp/codex-ci-affected-0649/.git/corvint/ci-0649/HANDOFF.md.
